yt.title: One emoji takes {c_b} bytes. A letter takes 1 #Shorts
yt.description:
In UTF-8, the grinning face emoji (U+1F600) takes {c_b} bytes; a plain ASCII letter takes 1.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: One emoji is not one byte
scenes.narration: A letter and an emoji look equally small on screen. They are not.

scenes.label: an emoji in UTF 8, versus 1 byte for a letter
scenes.narration: In UTF eight, a plain letter takes one byte. A smiley emoji takes {c_b_say} bytes.
Unicode has to fit every language and symbol, so some characters need more bytes than others.
